def track_developers(entries):
    """Split raw developer entries into front end and back end rosters."""
    frontend = list()
    backend = list()
    for name, role in entries:
        normalized = str(role).strip().lower()
        if normalized in ("frontend", "front end", "ui", "client"):
            frontend.append(name)
        elif normalized in ("backend", "back end", "api", "server"):
            backend.append(name)
    roster = {"frontend": frontend, "backend": backend}
    return roster


def manage(events):
    """Route project events into six categories and report their sizes."""
    open_bugs = list()
    resolved_bugs = list()
    planned_features = list()
    finished_features = list()
    logs_by_level = dict()
    developer_entries = list()
    for event in events:
        kind, description, metadata = event
        if kind == "bug":
            if metadata.get("status") == "resolved":
                resolved_bugs.append(description)
            else:
                open_bugs.append(description)
        elif kind == "feature":
            if metadata.get("status") == "done":
                finished_features.append(description)
            else:
                planned_features.append(description)
        elif kind == "developer":
            developer_entries.append((description, metadata.get("role", "")))
        elif kind == "log":
            level = metadata.get("level", "info")
            if level not in logs_by_level:
                logs_by_level[level] = list()
            logs_by_level[level].append(description)
    roster = track_developers(developer_entries)
    active_developers = len(roster["frontend"]) + len(roster["backend"])
    total_logs = sum(len(messages) for messages in logs_by_level.values())
    return (
        len(open_bugs),
        len(resolved_bugs),
        len(planned_features),
        len(finished_features),
        active_developers,
        total_logs,
    )


def format_report(counts):
    """Render the six category counts as an aligned text summary."""
    labels = (
        "Open bugs",
        "Resolved bugs",
        "Planned features",
        "Finished features",
        "Active developers",
        "System logs",
    )
    lines = list()
    width = max(len(label) for label in labels)
    for label, value in zip(labels, counts):
        lines.append("{0:<{1}} : {2}".format(label, width, value))
    return "\n".join(lines)


def main():
    events = [
        ("bug", "Crash on export", {"status": "open"}),
        ("bug", "Broken pagination", {"status": "resolved"}),
        ("feature", "Dark mode", {"status": "planned"}),
        ("feature", "CSV import", {"status": "done"}),
        ("feature", "Offline cache", {"status": "planned"}),

        ("log", "deploy finished", {"level": "info"}),
        ("log", "disk almost full", {"level": "warning"}),
        ("log", "cache miss spike", {"level": "warning"}),
    ]
    counts = manage(events)
    print(format_report(counts))
    print("summary tuple:", counts)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

SESSION_TIMEOUT = 1800
MOBILE_MARKERS = ("iphone", "android", "ipad", "mobile")


def parse_user_agents(agents):
    """Split raw user agent strings into mobile and desktop browser counts."""
    mobile = dict()
    desktop = dict()
    for raw in agents:
        agent = raw.strip()
        if not agent:
            continue
        lowered = agent.lower()
        if any(marker in lowered for marker in MOBILE_MARKERS):
            mobile[agent] = mobile.get(agent, 0) + 1
        else:
            desktop[agent] = desktop.get(agent, 0) + 1
    return mobile, desktop


def analyze(logs):
    """Scan log tuples (session, timestamp, endpoint, status, user_agent)."""
    active = dict()
    timed_out = list()
    error_groups = dict()
    success_endpoints = list()
    agents = list()
    hits = dict()
    for session, timestamp, endpoint, status, user_agent in logs:
        previous = active.get(session)
        if previous is not None and timestamp - previous > SESSION_TIMEOUT:
            timed_out.append(session)
        active[session] = timestamp
        hits[endpoint] = hits.get(endpoint, 0) + 1
        agents.append(user_agent)
        if status >= 400:
            if status not in error_groups:
                error_groups[status] = list()
            error_groups[status].append(endpoint)
        else:
            success_endpoints.append(endpoint)
    mobile, desktop = parse_user_agents(agents)
    return (
        len(active),
        len(timed_out),
        len(error_groups),
        len(success_endpoints),
        len(mobile) + len(desktop),
        len(hits),
    )

        "endpoints hit",
    )
    lines = list()
    for label, value in zip(labels, counts):

def parse_report(report):
    machine = str(report[0]).strip().upper()
    status = str(report[1]).strip().lower()
    note = report[2].strip() if len(report) > 2 and report[2] else ""
    return machine, status, note


def tally_notes(notes):
    praise = list()
    warnings = list()
    for text in notes:
        lowered = text.lower()
        if any(word in lowered for word in ("good", "excellent", "clean", "on time")):
            praise.append(text)
        elif any(word in lowered for word in ("unsafe", "hazard", "guard", "spill")):
            warnings.append(text)
    return praise, warnings


def group_failures(failures):
    groups = dict()
    current_machine = None
    sequence = list()
    for machine, detail in failures:
        if machine != current_machine:
            sequence = list()
            groups.setdefault(machine, list()).append(sequence)
            current_machine = machine
        sequence.append(detail)
    return groups


def inspect(widgets):
    passed = list()
    minor = list()
    critical = list()
    rework = list()
    scrapped = list()
    notes = list()
    for report in widgets:
        machine, status, note = parse_report(report)
        if note:
            notes.append(note)
        if status == "pass":
            passed.append(machine)
        elif status == "minor":
            minor.append(machine)
            rework.append(machine)
        elif status == "critical":
            critical.append((machine, note or status))
            scrapped.append(machine)
        elif status == "rework":
            rework.append(machine)
        elif status == "scrap":
            scrapped.append(machine)
    failure_groups = group_failures(critical)
    critical_total = sum(len(seq) for runs in failure_groups.values() for seq in runs)
    return (len(passed), len(minor), critical_total, len(rework),
            len(scrapped), len(notes))


def format_summary(counts, notes):

    lines.append("{:<18}: {}".format("positive feedback", len(praise)))
    lines.append("{:<18}: {}".format("safety warnings", len(warnings)))

text_es: Write a function explore(connections) that processes a sequence of transport links between cities. Each link is a tuple of two cities and a distance. The algorithm must group the links by origin city into a mapping. It must also initialize a queue of cities to explore, a list of visited cities, a mapping of shortest known distances from the starting city, and a mapping of predecessors to reconstruct paths. Additionally, it should track dead ends in a collection, alternative routes in another collection, and a sequence of explored nodes. The function should compute shortest paths from the first city to all others, returning a tuple containing the explored sequence and the dead ends. Example input: a link from alpha to beta with distance ten. Output: a tuple with the explored cities and any dead ends.

def group_by_origin(connections):
    graph = dict()
    for origin, destination, distance in connections:
        graph.setdefault(origin, list()).append((destination, distance))
    return graph


def search(connections):
    graph = group_by_origin(connections)
    queue = list()
    visited = list()
    distances = dict()
    predecessors = dict()
    dead_ends = list()
    alternatives = list()
    explored = list()
    if connections:
        start = connections[0][0]
        queue.append(start)
        distances[start] = 0
    while queue:
        current = min(queue, key=lambda city: distances[city])
        queue.remove(current)
        if current in visited:
            continue
        visited.append(current)
        explored.append(current)
        links = graph.get(current, list())
        if not links:
            dead_ends.append(current)
        for neighbour, distance in links:
            candidate = distances[current] + distance
            known = distances.get(neighbour)
            if known is None or candidate < known:
                distances[neighbour] = candidate
                predecessors[neighbour] = current
                queue.append(neighbour)
            elif candidate == known:
                alternatives.append((current, neighbour, candidate))
    state = dict()
    state["explored"] = explored
    state["dead_ends"] = dead_ends
    state["distances"] = distances
    state["predecessors"] = predecessors
    state["alternatives"] = alternatives
    return state


def explore(connections):
    state = search(connections)
    return state["explored"], state["dead_ends"]


def reconstruct_path(predecessors, target):
    path = list()
    city = target
    while city is not None:
        path.append(city)
        city = predecessors.get(city)
    path.reverse()
    return path


def report_lines(connections):
    state = search(connections)
    lines = list()
    for city in state["explored"]:
        route = reconstruct_path(state["predecessors"], city)
        lines.append("%s: %d via %s" % (city, state["distances"][city], " -> ".join(route)))
    if state["dead_ends"]:
        lines.append("dead ends: " + ", ".join(state["dead_ends"]))
    for origin, destination, distance in state["alternatives"]:
        lines.append("alternative route %s -> %s at %d" % (origin, destination, distance))
    return lines


def main():
    connections = [
        ("alpha", "beta", 10),
        ("alpha", "gamma", 25),
        ("beta", "gamma", 15),
        ("beta", "delta", 40),
        ("gamma", "delta", 25),
    ]
    explored, dead_ends = explore(connections)
    print("explored:", explored)
    print("dead ends:", dead_ends)
    for line in report_lines(connections):
        print(line)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def normalize_names(players):
    """Strip blanks and split the sequence into unique names and repeats."""
    cleaned = []
    repeats = []
    seen = {}
    for raw in players:
        name = str(raw).strip()
        if not name:
            continue
        key = name.casefold()
        if key in seen:
            repeats.append(name)
            continue
        seen[key] = name
        cleaned.append(name)
    return cleaned, repeats


def build_state(names):
    """Create the engine bookkeeping for a fresh competition."""
    state = {}
    state["active"] = list(names)
    state["eliminated"] = []
    state["disqualified"] = []
    state["byes"] = []
    scores = {}
    history = {}
    colors = {}
    tiebreaks = {}
    for index, name in enumerate(names):
        scores[name] = 0.0
        history[name] = []
        colors[name] = "white" if index % 2 == 0 else "black"
        tiebreaks[name] = 0.0
    state["scores"] = scores
    state["history"] = history
    state["colors"] = colors
    state["tiebreaks"] = tiebreaks
    return state


def choose_bye(state):
    """Remove and return the active player who receives the bye."""
    active = state["active"]
    scores = state["scores"]
    candidate = min(active, key=lambda name: (scores[name], name.casefold()))
    active.remove(candidate)
    state["byes"].append(candidate)
    scores[candidate] += 1.0
    state["tiebreaks"][candidate] += 0.5
    return candidate


def pair(players):
    """Build the first-round matchups, returning (matchups, bye_player)."""
    names, repeats = normalize_names(players)
    state = build_state(names)
    state["disqualified"].extend(repeats)
    active = state["active"]
    bye = choose_bye(state) if len(active) % 2 else None
    matchups = []
    history = state["history"]
    colors = state["colors"]
    for index in range(0, len(active) - 1, 2):
        white, black = active[index], active[index + 1]
        matchups.append((white, black))
        history[white].append(black)
        history[black].append(white)
        colors[white] = "white"
        colors[black] = "black"
    return matchups, bye


def format_round(matchups, bye):
    lines = []
    for number, (white, black) in enumerate(matchups, start=1):
        lines.append("Board {}: {} (white) vs {} (black)".format(number, white, black))
    if bye is not None:
        lines.append("Bye: {}".format(bye))
    return "\n".join(lines)


def main():
    entrants = ["Alice", "Bob", "Carol"]
    matchups, bye = pair(entrants)
    print(format_round(matchups, bye))
    print("Result:", (matchups, bye))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    state["scores"] = scores
    state["history"] = history
    state["colors"] = colors
    state["tiebreaks"] = tiebreaks
    return state


def choose_bye(state):
    """Remove and return the active player who receives the bye."""
    active = state["active"]
    scores = state["scores"]
    candidate = min(active, key=lambda name: (scores[name], name.casefold()))
    active.remove(candidate)
    state["byes"].append(candidate)
    scores[candidate] += 1.0
    state["tiebreaks"][candidate] += 0.5
    return candidate


def pair(players):
    """Build the first-round matchups, returning (matchups, bye_player)."""
    names, repeats = normalize_names(players)
    state = build_state(names)
    state["disqualified"].extend(repeats)
    active = state["active"]
    bye = choose_bye(state) if len(active) % 2 else None
    matchups = list()
    history = state["history"]
    colors = state["colors"]
    for index in range(0, len(active) - 1, 2):
        white, black = active[index], active[index + 1]
        matchups.append((white, black))
        history[white].append(black)
        history[black].append(white)
        colors[white] = "white"
        colors[black] = "black"
    return matchups, bye


def format_round(matchups, bye):
    lines = list()
    for number, (white, black) in enumerate(matchups, start=1):
        lines.append("Board {}: {} (white) vs {} (black)".format(number, white, black))
    if bye is not None:
        lines.append("Bye: {}".format(bye))
    return "\n".join(lines)


def main():
    entrants = ["Alice", "Bob", "Carol"]
    matchups, bye = pair(entrants)
    print(format_round(matchups, bye))
    print("Result:", (matchups, bye))

    main()

def load_catalog():

    inventory = dict()

        inventory[name] = count
    return prices, inventory


def deposit(bank, coins):
    for coin in coins:
        bank[coin] = bank.get(coin, 0) + 1


def withdraw(bank, coins):
    for coin in coins:
        bank[coin] -= 1
        if bank[coin] == 0:
            del bank[coin]


def make_change(amount, bank):
    change = list()
    for denom in sorted(bank, reverse=True):
        available = bank[denom]
        while amount >= denom and available > 0:
            change.append(denom)
            amount -= denom
            available -= 1
    if amount:
        return None
    return change


def format_report(inventory, bank, alerts, out_of_stock, insufficient):
    lines = list()
    failures = dict()
    for item in out_of_stock:
        failures[item] = failures.get(item, 0) + 1
    lines.append("inventory: " + ", ".join("%s=%d" % kv for kv in sorted(inventory.items())))
    lines.append("bank value: %d in %d coins" % (
        sum(d * c for d, c in bank.items()), sum(bank.values())))
    for item, count in sorted(failures.items()):
        lines.append("out of stock refusals for %s: %d" % (item, count))
    for item, missing in insufficient:
        lines.append("insufficient funds for %s: %d short" % (item, missing))
    lines.extend("ALERT: " + text for text in alerts)
    return "\n".join(lines)


def vend(transactions):

    dispensed = list()
    returned = list()
    out_of_stock = list()
    insufficient = list()
    alerts = list()
    bank = dict()
    for txn in transactions:

        coins = list(txn.get("coins", list()))
        paid = sum(coins)
        if item not in prices:
            alerts.append("unknown selection %r" % (item,))
            returned.extend(coins)
        elif inventory[item] <= 0:
            out_of_stock.append(item)
            returned.extend(coins)
        elif paid < prices[item]:
            insufficient.append((item, prices[item] - paid))
            returned.extend(coins)
        else:
            deposit(bank, coins)
            change = make_change(paid - prices[item], bank)
            if change is None:
                withdraw(bank, coins)
                alerts.append("exact change required for %s" % item)
                returned.extend(coins)
                continue
            withdraw(bank, change)
            inventory[item] -= 1
            dispensed.append(item)
            returned.extend(change)
            if inventory[item] == 0:
                alerts.append("restock %s" % item)
    print(format_report(inventory, bank, alerts, out_of_stock, insufficient))
    return dispensed, returned

It also requires a mapping of track segment occupancies, a mapping of station arrival times, a list of detected conflicts, and a list of emergency stops. The simulation advances time, moving trains along segments and recording a conflict if two trains require the same segment simultaneously. The function returns a tuple of the detected conflicts and the arrived trains. Example input: two trains scheduled on the same track at the same time. Output: one detected conflict, zero arrived.

DWELL = 2


def normalize(trains):
    """Turn the raw route descriptions into uniform dictionaries."""
    routes = list()
    for index, entry in enumerate(trains):
        if isinstance(entry, dict):
            train_id = str(entry.get("id", "T%d" % index))
            depart = int(entry.get("depart", 0))
            segments = list(entry.get("segments", list()))
            alternate = list(entry.get("alternate", list()))
        else:
            train_id, depart, segments = str(entry[0]), int(entry[1]), list(entry[2])
            alternate = list(entry[3]) if len(entry) > 3 else list()
        if not segments:
            raise ValueError("train %s has no track segments" % train_id)
        routes.append({"id": train_id, "depart": depart,
                       "segments": segments, "alternate": alternate})
    return routes


def dispatch(trains):
    """Simulate the network and return (conflicts, arrived)."""
    routes = normalize(trains)
    active = list()
    delayed = list()
    rerouted = list()
    arrived = list()
    occupancy = dict()
    station_times = dict()
    conflicts = list()
    emergency = list()
    positions = dict()
    ready = dict()
    pending = sorted(routes, key=lambda r: (r["depart"], r["id"]))
    limit = max([r["depart"] for r in routes] + [0]) + DWELL * sum(
        len(r["segments"]) + len(r["alternate"]) for r in routes) + 2
    t = 0
    while (pending or active) and t <= limit:
        while pending and pending[0]["depart"] <= t:
            train = pending.pop(0)
            active.append(train)
            positions[train["id"]] = 0
            ready[train["id"]] = t
        requests = dict()
        for train in active:
            if ready[train["id"]] <= t:
                segment = train["segments"][positions[train["id"]]]
                requests.setdefault(segment, list()).append(train["id"])
        by_id = dict((train["id"], train) for train in active)
        for segment in sorted(requests):
            ids = requests[segment]
            holder = occupancy.get(segment)
            blocked = (holder is not None and holder[0] not in ids
                       and (holder[1] > t or holder[0] in emergency))
            if len(ids) > 1 or blocked:
                involved = list(ids) + ([holder[0]] if blocked else list())
                conflict = {"time": t, "segment": segment,
                            "trains": involved, "stopped": list()}
                conflicts.append(conflict)
                for train_id in ids:
                    train = by_id[train_id]
                    if train["alternate"] and train_id not in rerouted and delayed.count(train_id) < 2:
                        train["segments"] = train["alternate"]
                        positions[train_id] = 0
                        ready[train_id] = t + 1
                        rerouted.append(train_id)
                        delayed.append(train_id)
                    else:
                        emergency.append(train_id)
                        occupancy[segment] = (train_id, t)
                        conflict["stopped"].append(train_id)
                        active.remove(train)
            else:
                train = by_id[ids[0]]
                occupancy[segment] = (train["id"], t + DWELL)
                ready[train["id"]] = t + DWELL
                positions[train["id"]] += 1
                if positions[train["id"]] >= len(train["segments"]):
                    station_times[train["id"]] = t + DWELL
                    arrived.append((train["id"], station_times[train["id"]]))
                    active.remove(train)
        t += 1
    return conflicts, arrived


def summarize(conflicts, arrived):
    by_segment = dict()
    for conflict in conflicts:
        by_segment.setdefault(conflict["segment"], list()).append(conflict)
    lines = ["conflicts: %d" % len(conflicts)]
    for segment in sorted(by_segment):
        for conflict in by_segment[segment]:
            lines.append("  t=%d %s: %s stopped=%s" % (
                conflict["time"], segment, "+".join(conflict["trains"]),
                ",".join(conflict["stopped"]) or "-"))
    lines.append("arrived: %d" % len(arrived))
    for train_id, moment in arrived:
        lines.append("  %s at t=%d" % (train_id, moment))
    return lines


def main():

        {"id": "IC1", "depart": 0, "segments": ["A-B"]},
        {"id": "IC2", "depart": 0, "segments": ["A-B"]},
        ("RE7", 1, ["B-C", "C-D"], ["B-E", "E-D"]),
        ("RE9", 1, ["B-C"]),
    ]
    conflicts, arrived = dispatch(timetable)
    print("\n".join(summarize(conflicts, arrived)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

CATALOGUE = """
bolt 0.25 0.5 acme-fasteners
wire 0.40 1.0 wirewurks
bamboo-shell 1.10 1.5 green-goods
alloy-frame 3.20 2.5 castworks
lithium-cell 4.75 0.5 voltaic-supply
gear - 2.0 gearco
display-panel - 1.5 lumen-parts
"""

ECO_PARTS = frozenset({"bolt", "wire", "bamboo-shell"})
RESTRICTED_PARTS = frozenset({"lithium-cell"})
LABOUR_RATE = 0.35
HIGH_MARGIN_SHARE = 0.4


def parse_catalogue(text=CATALOGUE):
    unit_costs = dict()
    assembly_times = dict()
    for line in text.strip().splitlines():
        part, price, minutes, _supplier = line.split()
        assembly_times[part] = float(minutes)
        if price != "-":
            unit_costs[part] = float(price)
    return unit_costs, assembly_times


def parse_suppliers(text=CATALOGUE):
    suppliers = dict()
    for line in text.strip().splitlines():
        fields = line.split()
        suppliers[fields[0]] = fields[3]
    return suppliers


def build_categories(products, unit_costs, assembly_times):
    high_margin = list()
    loss_leaders = list()
    eco_friendly = list()
    export_only = list()
    out_of_stock = list()
    for name, parts, price in products:
        total = 0.0
        minutes = 0.0
        for part in parts:
            if part in unit_costs:
                total += unit_costs[part]
                minutes += assembly_times[part]
            elif part not in out_of_stock:
                out_of_stock.append(part)
        total += minutes * LABOUR_RATE
        margin = price - total
        if margin <= 0:
            loss_leaders.append(name)
        elif margin >= price * HIGH_MARGIN_SHARE:
            high_margin.append(name)
        if all(part in ECO_PARTS for part in parts):
            eco_friendly.append(name)
        if any(part in RESTRICTED_PARTS for part in parts):
            export_only.append(name)
    categories = dict()
    categories["high_margin"] = high_margin
    categories["loss_leaders"] = loss_leaders
    categories["eco_friendly"] = eco_friendly
    categories["export_only"] = export_only
    return categories, out_of_stock


def cost(products):
    unit_costs, assembly_times = parse_catalogue()
    categories, out_of_stock = build_categories(products, unit_costs, assembly_times)
    return categories["high_margin"], out_of_stock


def restock_orders(out_of_stock, suppliers):
    orders = dict()
    for part in out_of_stock:
        contact = suppliers.get(part, "unknown-supplier")
        orders.setdefault(contact, list()).append(part)
    return orders


def main():
    products = [
        ("keyring", ("bolt", "wire"), 9.50),
        ("bamboo lamp", ("bamboo-shell", "wire", "bolt"), 4.00),
        ("power pack", ("lithium-cell", "alloy-frame"), 12.00),
        ("clock module", ("gear", "display-panel", "bolt"), 30.00),
    ]
    high_margin, missing = cost(products)
    print("high margin:", ", ".join(high_margin))
    print("missing parts:", len(missing))
    for contact, parts in sorted(restock_orders(missing, parse_suppliers()).items()):
        print("  order from %s: %s" % (contact, ", ".join(parts)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

The entry function build(organisms) processes flat species records to form a biological hierarchy. Initialize a mapping for the root domains, a tracking directory for known kingdoms, and a separate registry for phyla. Maintain distinct lists to collect newly discovered species, extinct species, and unclassified genetic anomalies. Keep a registry mapping scientific names to their common names and a separate mapping for habitat types. Return a tuple with the total categorized species and the count of unclassified anomalies.

REQUIRED_FIELDS = ("domain", "kingdom", "phylum", "species")


def normalize(record):
    """Return a copy of a raw record with trimmed strings and lowercase status."""
    cleaned = dict()
    for key, value in record.items():
        if isinstance(value, str):
            value = value.strip()
        cleaned[key] = value
    cleaned["status"] = str(cleaned.get("status", "known")).lower()
    return cleaned


def is_anomaly(record):
    """A record is an unclassified genetic anomaly if any taxon level is missing."""
    return any(not record.get(field) for field in REQUIRED_FIELDS)


def register(domains, kingdoms, phyla, record):
    """Insert one validated record into the three taxonomic registries."""
    domain, kingdom = record["domain"], record["kingdom"]
    phylum, species = record["phylum"], record["species"]
    if domain not in domains:
        domains[domain] = dict()
    branch = domains[domain]
    if kingdom not in branch:
        branch[kingdom] = list()
    if phylum not in branch[kingdom]:
        branch[kingdom].append(phylum)
    if kingdom not in kingdoms:
        kingdoms[kingdom] = list()
    kingdoms[kingdom].append(species)
    if phylum not in phyla:
        phyla[phylum] = dict()
    phyla[phylum][species] = record.get("habitat", "unknown")


def group_by_habitat(habitats):
    """Invert the species -> habitat mapping into habitat -> species names."""
    buckets = dict()
    for species, habitat in sorted(habitats.items()):
        if habitat not in buckets:
            buckets[habitat] = list()
        buckets[habitat].append(species)
    return buckets


def summarize(domains, common_names, habitats):
    lines = list()
    for domain in sorted(domains):
        lines.append(domain)
        for kingdom in sorted(domains[domain]):
            joined = ", ".join(sorted(domains[domain][kingdom]))
            lines.append("  {0} -> {1}".format(kingdom, joined))
    for habitat, members in sorted(group_by_habitat(habitats).items()):
        named = [common_names.get(name, name) for name in members]
        lines.append("{0}: {1}".format(habitat, ", ".join(named)))
    return lines


def build(organisms):
    domains = dict()
    kingdoms = dict()
    phyla = dict()
    new_species = list()
    extinct_species = list()
    anomalies = list()
    common_names = dict()
    habitats = dict()
    for raw in organisms:
        record = normalize(raw)
        if is_anomaly(record):
            anomalies.append(record)
            continue
        register(domains, kingdoms, phyla, record)
        species = record["species"]
        if record.get("common_name"):
            common_names[species] = record["common_name"]
        habitats[species] = record.get("habitat", "unknown")
        if record["status"] == "new":
            new_species.append(species)
        elif record["status"] == "extinct":
            extinct_species.append(species)
    total = sum(len(members) for members in kingdoms.values())
    for line in summarize(domains, common_names, habitats):
        print(line)
    print("phyla tracked: {0}".format(len(phyla)))
    print("newly discovered: {0}".format(", ".join(sorted(new_species)) or "none"))
    print("extinct: {0}".format(", ".join(sorted(extinct_species)) or "none"))
    return total, len(anomalies)


def main():

        {"domain": "Eukarya", "kingdom": "Animalia", "phylum": "Chordata",
         "species": "Panthera leo", "common_name": "lion", "habitat": "savanna"},
        {"domain": "Eukarya", "kingdom": "Animalia", "phylum": "Arthropoda",
         "species": "Apis mellifera", "common_name": "honey bee", "habitat": "meadow",
         "status": "new"},
        {"domain": "Eukarya", "kingdom": "Plantae", "phylum": "Bryophyta",
         "species": "Sphagnum palustre", "habitat": "bog"},
        {"domain": "Bacteria", "kingdom": "Monera", "phylum": "Proteobacteria",
         "species": "Escherichia coli", "habitat": "gut"},
        {"domain": "Eukarya", "kingdom": "Animalia", "phylum": "Chordata",
         "species": "Raphus cucullatus", "common_name": "dodo", "habitat": "forest",
         "status": "extinct"},
        {"domain": "", "kingdom": "Animalia", "phylum": "", "species": "sample-77"},
    ]
    total, unclassified = build(organisms)
    print("categorized {0} species, {1} anomalies".format(total, unclassified))

    main()

Keep lists for players waiting for teammates, disconnected users, and penalized users. Return a tuple of total active matches and total players currently waiting.
text_alt:
TIERS = ("novice", "intermediate", "advanced", "expert")
CHARACTERS = ("Ranger", "Mage", "Rogue", "Cleric")
TEAM_SIZE = 2


def triage(players):
    """Split the roster into playable entries, disconnected users and penalized users."""
    eligible = list()
    disconnected = list()
    penalized = list()
    for player in players:
        if player.get("status") != "connected":
            disconnected.append(player["id"])
        elif player.get("penalties", 0) > 0:
            penalized.append(player["id"])
        else:
            eligible.append(player)
    return eligible, disconnected, penalized


def collect_latency(players):
    """Map every player identifier to the latency score reported by the client."""
    latency = dict()
    for player in players:
        latency[player["id"]] = player.get("latency", 999)
    return latency


def bucket_by_skill(players):
    novice = list()
    intermediate = list()
    advanced = list()
    expert = list()
    queues = dict(zip(TIERS, (novice, intermediate, advanced, expert)))
    for player in players:
        tier = player.get("skill", "novice")
        queues.get(tier, novice).append(player["id"])
    return queues


def form_teams(queue, size):
    """Chop an ordered queue into full teams, returning the teams and the leftovers."""
    teams = list()
    current = list()
    for pid in queue:
        current.append(pid)
        if len(current) == size:
            teams.append(current)
            current = list()
    return teams, current


def pick_characters(teams, tier):
    registry = dict()
    for index, team in enumerate(teams):
        chosen = list()
        for offset, pid in enumerate(team):
            chosen.append(CHARACTERS[(index + offset) % len(CHARACTERS)])
        registry[(tier, tuple(team))] = chosen
    return registry


def match(players):
    eligible, disconnected, penalized = triage(players)
    latency = collect_latency(eligible)
    queues = bucket_by_skill(eligible)
    team_characters = dict()
    waiting = list()
    for tier in TIERS:
        queue = sorted(queues[tier], key=lambda pid: latency[pid])
        teams, leftover = form_teams(queue, TEAM_SIZE)
        team_characters.update(pick_characters(teams, tier))
        waiting.extend(leftover)
    print("dropped: %d, penalized: %d" % (len(disconnected), len(penalized)))
    for (tier, team), roles in sorted(team_characters.items()):
        print("  %-12s %s" % (tier, ", ".join("%s/%s" % pair for pair in zip(team, roles))))
    return len(team_characters), len(waiting)


def main():
    roster = list()
    raw = [
        ("ann", "novice", 40, "connected", 0), ("bob", "novice", 90, "connected", 0),
        ("cid", "novice", 15, "connected", 0), ("dot", "expert", 55, "connected", 0),
        ("eve", "expert", 22, "connected", 2), ("fay", "advanced", 70, "disconnected", 0),
        ("gus", "intermediate", 33, "connected", 0), ("hal", "intermediate", 61, "connected", 0),
    ]
    for pid, skill, ping, status, strikes in raw:
        roster.append({"id": pid, "skill": skill, "latency": ping,
                       "status": status, "penalties": strikes})
    active, waiting = match(roster)
    print("active matches: %d | players waiting: %d" % (active, waiting))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Initialize a directory of available beds and a mapping of assigned attending doctors. Keep lists for patients needing immediate blood tests, patients waiting for imaging, and patients ready for discharge. Return a tuple containing the total admitted count and the discharged count.
text_alt:
WARD_CAPACITY = {"trauma": 2, "urgent": 3, "observation": 2, "outpatient": 4}
WARD_DOCTORS = {
    "trauma": "Dr. Adeyemi",
    "urgent": "Dr. Okafor",
    "observation": "Dr. Lin",
    "outpatient": "Dr. Ruiz",
}
WARD_OF_SEVERITY = {
    "critical": "trauma",
    "urgent": "urgent",
    "stable": "observation",
    "minor": "outpatient",
}


def parse_patients(rows):
    patients = list()
    for row in rows:
        fields = [field.strip() for field in row.split(",")]
        if len(fields) != 3:
            continue
        name, severity, status = fields
        patients.append({"name": name, "severity": severity.lower(), "status": status.lower()})
    return patients


def open_beds(capacity):
    beds = dict()
    for ward, count in capacity.items():
        beds[ward] = ["%s-%d" % (ward[:3].upper(), n) for n in range(1, count + 1)]
    return beds


def assign_bed(beds, ward):
    free = beds.get(ward, list())
    if free:
        return free.pop(0)
    return None


def triage(patients):
    critical_trauma = list()
    urgent_care = list()
    stable_condition = list()
    minor_injuries = list()
    queues = {
        "critical": critical_trauma,
        "urgent": urgent_care,
        "stable": stable_condition,
        "minor": minor_injuries,
    }
    beds = open_beds(WARD_CAPACITY)
    attending = dict()
    blood_tests = list()
    awaiting_imaging = list()
    ready_for_discharge = list()
    admitted = 0
    discharged = 0
    for patient in patients:
        name = patient["name"]
        severity = patient["severity"]
        if patient["status"] == "discharge":
            ready_for_discharge.append(name)
            discharged += 1
            continue
        queues.get(severity, minor_injuries).append(name)
        bed = assign_bed(beds, WARD_OF_SEVERITY.get(severity, "outpatient"))
        if bed is None:
            continue
        attending[name] = (WARD_DOCTORS[WARD_OF_SEVERITY.get(severity, "outpatient")], bed)
        admitted += 1
        if severity in ("critical", "urgent"):
            blood_tests.append(name)
        if severity == "critical" or patient["status"] == "trauma":
            awaiting_imaging.append(name)
    for name in sorted(attending):
        doctor, bed = attending[name]
        print("%-10s -> %s (%s)" % (name, doctor, bed))
    print("blood tests: %s" % ", ".join(blood_tests))
    print("imaging queue: %s" % ", ".join(awaiting_imaging))
    print("discharge list: %s" % ", ".join(ready_for_discharge))
    return admitted, discharged


def format_report(patients, admitted, discharged):
    counts = dict()
    for patient in patients:
        counts[patient["severity"]] = counts.get(patient["severity"], 0) + 1
    lines = list()
    for severity in ("critical", "urgent", "stable", "minor"):
        lines.append("%-8s %d case(s)" % (severity, counts.get(severity, 0)))
    lines.append("admitted %d / discharged %d" % (admitted, discharged))
    return "\n".join(lines)


def main():
    rows = [
        "Mensah, critical, trauma",
        "Novak, urgent, walk-in",
        "Ito, stable, transfer",
        "Barros, minor, walk-in",
        "Haddad, critical, trauma",
        "Silva, stable, discharge",
        "Kowal, critical, walk-in",
        "Tran, minor, discharge",
    ]
    patients = parse_patients(rows)
    admitted, discharged = triage(patients)
    print(format_report(patients, admitted, discharged))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

text_es: The entry function rebalance(accounts) adjusts investment holdings to match target allocations. Create separate lists to track buy orders, sell orders, hold recommendations, and restricted insider trades. Initialize a mapping of current market asset prices and a directory of client risk profiles. Maintain a queue for transactions pending broker approval and a list of failed transactions due to insufficient funds. Return a tuple of total executed trades and total failed trades.
text_alt:
def load_market_prices(accounts):
    prices = dict()
    for acct in accounts:
        for symbol, price in acct.get("quotes", dict()).items():
            prices[symbol] = price
    return prices


def load_risk_profiles(accounts):
    profiles = dict()
    for acct in accounts:
        profiles[acct["id"]] = acct.get("risk", "moderate")
    return profiles


RISK_CAPS = {"conservative": 0.30, "moderate": 0.60, "aggressive": 1.00}


def portfolio_value(holdings, prices):
    total = 0.0
    for symbol, shares in holdings.items():
        total += shares * prices.get(symbol, 0.0)
    return total


def plan_orders(acct, prices, cap):
    buys = list()
    sells = list()
    holds = list()
    restricted = list()
    equity = portfolio_value(acct["holdings"], prices) + acct["cash"]
    blocked = acct.get("insider_symbols", list())
    for symbol, weight in acct["targets"].items():
        price = prices.get(symbol, 0.0)
        if price <= 0.0:
            continue
        target_shares = equity * min(weight, cap) / price
        delta = round(target_shares - acct["holdings"].get(symbol, 0.0), 2)
        order = {"client": acct["id"], "symbol": symbol,
                 "shares": abs(delta), "price": price,
                 "side": "buy" if delta > 0 else "sell"}
        if symbol in blocked:
            restricted.append(order)
        elif delta > 0.01:
            buys.append(order)
        elif delta < -0.01:
            sells.append(order)
        else:
            holds.append(order)
    return buys, sells, holds, restricted


def rebalance(accounts):
    prices = load_market_prices(accounts)
    profiles = load_risk_profiles(accounts)
    pending = list()
    failed = list()
    all_buys = list()
    all_sells = list()
    all_holds = list()
    all_restricted = list()
    for acct in accounts:
        cap = RISK_CAPS.get(profiles[acct["id"]], 0.60)
        buys, sells, holds, restricted = plan_orders(acct, prices, cap)
        all_buys.extend(buys)
        all_sells.extend(sells)
        all_holds.extend(holds)
        all_restricted.extend(restricted)
        pending.extend(sells + buys)
    cash = dict()
    for acct in accounts:
        cash[acct["id"]] = acct["cash"]
    executed = 0
    while pending:
        order = pending.pop(0)
        proceeds = order["shares"] * order["price"]
        if order["side"] == "sell":
            cash[order["client"]] += proceeds
            executed += 1
        elif cash[order["client"]] >= proceeds:
            cash[order["client"]] -= proceeds
            executed += 1
        else:
            failed.append(order)
    print("holds:", len(all_holds), "restricted:", len(all_restricted))
    return executed, len(failed)


def main():
    accounts = [
        {"id": "A1", "risk": "aggressive", "cash": 5000.0,
         "holdings": {"ACME": 40.0, "BOND": 10.0},
         "targets": {"ACME": 0.5, "BOND": 0.5},
         "quotes": {"ACME": 100.0, "BOND": 50.0}},
        {"id": "A2", "risk": "conservative", "cash": 100.0,
         "holdings": {"ACME": 5.0}, "insider_symbols": ["ACME"],
         "targets": {"ACME": 0.3, "BOND": 0.7},
         "quotes": {"BOND": 50.0}},
    ]
    done, failures = rebalance(accounts)
    print("executed: %d, failed: %d" % (done, failures))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

text_alt:
BLOCKLIST_THRESHOLD = 3
FAILED_LOGIN_LIMIT = 2


def parse_log(line):
    """Turn 'key=value;key=value' text into a dictionary."""
    record = dict()
    for field in line.strip().split(";"):
        if "=" in field:
            key, value = field.split("=", 1)
            record[key.strip()] = value.strip()
    return record


def load_signatures():
    """Known malware signatures mapped to the family they belong to."""
    signatures = dict()
    signatures["eicar"] = "test-file"
    signatures["mimikatz"] = "credential-dumper"
    signatures["cobaltstrike"] = "beacon"
    return signatures


def match_signature(payload, signatures):
    lowered = payload.lower()
    for token, family in signatures.items():
        if token in lowered:
            return family
    return None


def correlate(logs):
    blocked_addresses = list()
    suspicious_payloads = list()
    unauthorized_logins = list()
    background_traffic = list()
    signatures = load_signatures()
    compromised_accounts = dict()
    severe_alerts = list()
    offline_sensors = list()
    hit_counts = dict()

    for line in logs:
        record = parse_log(line)
        source = record.get("src", "unknown")
        sensor = record.get("sensor", "unknown")
        if record.get("status") == "sensor_down":
            offline_sensors.append(sensor)
            continue
        family = match_signature(record.get("payload", ""), signatures)
        if family:
            suspicious_payloads.append((source, family))
            severe_alerts.append("malware %s from %s" % (family, source))
            hit_counts[source] = hit_counts.get(source, 0) + 1
        elif record.get("event") == "login_failed":
            user = record.get("user", "unknown")
            unauthorized_logins.append((source, user))
            attempts = compromised_accounts.setdefault(user, list())
            attempts.append(source)
            if len(attempts) >= FAILED_LOGIN_LIMIT:
                severe_alerts.append("account %s under attack" % user)
                hit_counts[source] = hit_counts.get(source, 0) + 1
        else:
            background_traffic.append(source)
        if hit_counts.get(source, 0) >= BLOCKLIST_THRESHOLD:
            if source not in blocked_addresses:
                blocked_addresses.append(source)

    for alert in severe_alerts:
        print("ALERT:", alert)
    print("normal packets: %d, offline sensors: %d" %
          (len(background_traffic), len(offline_sensors)))
    print("distinct suspicious payloads: %d, failed logins: %d" %
          (len(suspicious_payloads), len(unauthorized_logins)))
    return blocked_addresses, compromised_accounts


def main():
    logs = [
        "sensor=s1;src=10.0.0.5;payload=hello world",
        "sensor=s1;src=10.0.0.9;payload=EICAR-test",
        "sensor=s1;src=10.0.0.9;payload=mimikatz dump",
        "sensor=s2;status=sensor_down",
        "sensor=s1;src=10.0.0.9;event=login_failed;user=admin",
        "sensor=s1;src=10.0.0.9;event=login_failed;user=admin",
        "sensor=s1;src=10.0.0.5;event=login_failed;user=guest",
    ]
    blocked, accounts = correlate(logs)
    print("blocked:", ", ".join(blocked) or "none")
    for user, origins in sorted(accounts.items()):
        print("compromised %s via %s" % (user, ", ".join(origins)))

    main()

The input consists of a list of cycles, each a tuple of a cycle identifier and a sequence of claim amounts. text_alt:
SUSPICIOUS_LIMIT = 10000.0
REVIEW_LIMIT = 5000.0


def normalize_cycles(raw):
    """Turn raw submissions into (cycle_id, [amount, ...]) tuples."""
    cycles = list()
    for entry in raw:
        cycle_id, raw_amounts = entry
        amounts = list()
        for value in raw_amounts:
            try:
                amounts.append(float(value))
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                continue
        cycles.append((str(cycle_id), amounts))
    return cycles


def insurance(cycles):
    policy_deductibles = dict()
    approved_claims = list()
    adjuster_workloads = dict()
    rejected_applications = list()
    client_premiums = dict()
    pending_reviews = list()

    for index, (cycle_id, amounts) in enumerate(cycles):
        fraudulent_flags = list()
        coverage_adjustments = dict()
        adjuster = "adjuster-%d" % (index % 3 + 1)
        for position, amount in enumerate(amounts):
            if amount < 0 or amount > SUSPICIOUS_LIMIT:
                fraudulent_flags.append((cycle_id, position, amount))
                continue
            coverage_adjustments[position] = round(amount * 0.9, 2)
            adjuster_workloads[adjuster] = adjuster_workloads.get(adjuster, 0) + 1
            if amount >= REVIEW_LIMIT:
                pending_reviews.append((cycle_id, position, amount))
            else:
                approved_claims.append((cycle_id, position, amount))
        covered = sum(coverage_adjustments.values())
        policy_deductibles[cycle_id] = round(covered * 0.05, 2)
        rejected_applications.append(fraudulent_flags)
        client_premiums.setdefault(cycle_id, dict()).update(coverage_adjustments)

    return (policy_deductibles, approved_claims, adjuster_workloads,
            rejected_applications, client_premiums, pending_reviews)


def format_report(trackers):
    deductibles, approved, workloads, rejected, premiums, pending = trackers
    lines = list()
    flagged = list()
    for batch in rejected:
        flagged.extend(batch)
    lines.append("cycles reviewed: %d" % len(deductibles))
    lines.append("approved claims: %d" % len(approved))
    lines.append("pending reviews: %d" % len(pending))
    lines.append("flagged amounts: %d" % len(flagged))
    for adjuster in sorted(workloads):
        lines.append("  %s handled %d claim(s)" % (adjuster, workloads[adjuster]))
    for cycle_id in sorted(premiums):
        adjustments = premiums[cycle_id]
        total = round(sum(adjustments.values()), 2)
        lines.append("  %s: premium %.2f, deductible %.2f"
                     % (cycle_id, total, deductibles[cycle_id]))
    for cycle_id, position, amount in flagged:
        lines.append("  FLAG %s slot %d amount %.2f" % (cycle_id, position, amount))
    return lines


def main():
    submissions = [
        ("C-1001", [1200, 4999.5, "bad", 7500]),
        ("C-1002", [-40, 250, 12000, 3000]),
        ("C-1003", list()),
    ]
    trackers = insurance(normalize_cycles(submissions))
    for line in format_report(trackers):
        print(line)
    print("empty run:", insurance(list()))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

SECTION_CAPACITY = {"floor": 4, "balcony": 3, "lawn": 5}


def classify_requests(requests):
    """Split incoming forms into priority guests, regular buyers and rejects."""
    prominent_guests = list()
    standard_buyers = list()
    rejected_forms = list()
    for form in requests:
        name = form.get("name", "").strip()
        seats = form.get("seats", 0)
        section = form.get("section", "")
        if not name:
            rejected_forms.append({"form": form, "reason": "missing name"})
        elif not isinstance(seats, int) or seats < 1:
            rejected_forms.append({"form": form, "reason": "invalid seat count"})
        elif section not in SECTION_CAPACITY:
            rejected_forms.append({"form": form, "reason": "unknown section"})
        elif form.get("vip"):
            prominent_guests.append({"name": name, "seats": seats, "section": section})
        else:
            standard_buyers.append({"name": name, "seats": seats, "section": section})
    return prominent_guests, standard_buyers, rejected_forms


def assign_seating(ordered_requests):
    """Fill sections in priority order, reporting who got in and who did not."""
    filled_seats = dict()
    buyer_sections = dict()
    unseated = list()
    for order in ordered_requests:
        section = order["section"]
        taken = filled_seats.get(section, 0)
        if order["seats"] <= SECTION_CAPACITY[section] - taken:
            filled_seats[section] = taken + order["seats"]
            held = buyer_sections.setdefault(order["name"], list())
            held.append((section, order["seats"]))
        else:
            unseated.append(order)
    return filled_seats, buyer_sections, unseated


def handle_overflow(unseated, paid_lookup):
    """Route unseated buyers to refunds (already paid) or the standby line."""
    refund_seekers = list()
    standby_line = list()
    for order in unseated:
        if paid_lookup.get(order["name"]):
            refund_seekers.append(order)
        else:
            standby_line.append(order)
    return refund_seekers, standby_line


def summarize_occupancy(filled_seats):
    """Per-section occupancy lines for the printed manifest."""
    lines = list()
    for section in sorted(SECTION_CAPACITY):
        lines.append("%-8s %d/%d" % (section, filled_seats.get(section, 0), SECTION_CAPACITY[section]))
    return lines


def queue(requests):
    manifest = dict()
    prominent, standard, rejected = classify_requests(requests)
    filled, buyer_sections, unseated = assign_seating(prominent + standard)
    paid_lookup = dict()
    for form in requests:
        paid_lookup[form.get("name", "").strip()] = form.get("paid", False)
    refunds, standby = handle_overflow(unseated, paid_lookup)
    manifest["seating"] = buyer_sections
    manifest["occupancy"] = filled
    manifest["rejected"] = rejected
    manifest["refunds"] = refunds
    manifest["standby"] = standby
    manifest["report"] = summarize_occupancy(filled)
    return manifest

        {"name": "Di", "seats": 0, "section": "lawn", "paid": True},
        {"name": "Eve", "seats": 6, "section": "lawn"},
    ]
    result = queue(incoming)
    for line in result["report"]:
        print(line)
    print("seated:", result["seating"])

    print("standby:", [s["name"] for s in result["standby"]])
    print("rejected:", [(r["form"].get("name"), r["reason"]) for r in result["rejected"]])

ALLOWED_SPECIES = {"dog": "dogs", "cat": "cats", "bird": "birds"}


def parse_profile(text):
    """Turn a text profile 'name | species | owner | notes' into a dict."""
    fields = [part.strip() for part in text.split("|")]
    if len(fields) < 3:
        raise ValueError("profile needs name, species and owner: %r" % text)
    profile = dict()
    profile["name"] = fields[0]
    profile["species"] = fields[1].lower()
    profile["owner"] = fields[2]
    if profile["species"] not in ALLOWED_SPECIES:
        raise ValueError("unsupported species: %r" % fields[1])
    notes = list()
    if len(fields) > 3 and fields[3]:
        for tag in fields[3].split(","):
            notes.append(tag.strip().lower())
    profile["notes"] = notes
    return profile


def sort_by_species(profiles):
    """Split the guests into one list per species."""
    dogs = list()
    cats = list()
    birds = list()
    kennels = {"dogs": dogs, "cats": cats, "birds": birds}
    for profile in profiles:
        kennels[ALLOWED_SPECIES[profile["species"]]].append(profile["name"])
    return kennels


def medical_review(profiles):
    """Collect kitchen and nurse duties from the profile notes."""
    special_diets = list()
    medication_alerts = list()
    for profile in profiles:
        for note in profile["notes"]:
            if note.startswith("diet:"):
                special_diets.append((profile["name"], note[5:].strip()))
            elif note.startswith("med:"):
                medication_alerts.append((profile["name"], note[4:].strip()))
    return special_diets, medication_alerts


def assign_rooms(profiles, first_room=101):
    """Group pets per owner, then give neighbouring rooms to each household."""
    owner_pets = dict()
    room_numbers = dict()
    for profile in profiles:
        owner_pets.setdefault(profile["owner"], list()).append(profile["name"])
    room = first_room
    for owner in sorted(owner_pets):
        for name in owner_pets[owner]:
            room_numbers[name] = room
            room += 1
    return owner_pets, room_numbers


def format_roster(profiles, room_numbers):
    """Human readable check-in list, one line per guest."""
    lines = list()
    for profile in sorted(profiles, key=lambda p: room_numbers[p["name"]]):
        lines.append("%d: %s (%s) - owner %s" % (room_numbers[profile["name"]],
                                                 profile["name"],
                                                 profile["species"],
                                                 profile["owner"]))
    return lines


def schedule(pets):
    """Build the daily report for every text profile in 'pets'."""
    report = dict()
    profiles = [parse_profile(text) for text in pets]
    owner_pets, room_numbers = assign_rooms(profiles)
    special_diets, medication_alerts = medical_review(profiles)
    report["guests"] = len(profiles)
    report["by_species"] = sort_by_species(profiles)
    report["households"] = owner_pets
    report["rooms"] = room_numbers
    report["special_diets"] = special_diets
    report["medication_alerts"] = medication_alerts
    report["roster"] = format_roster(profiles, room_numbers)
    return report


def main():

        "Bruno | dog | Carol | med:insulin",
    ]
    daily = schedule(guests)
    for line in daily["roster"]:
        print(line)
    print("meds due:", len(daily["medication_alerts"]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def sort_clips(segments):
    """Group segment records by their production role."""
    intros = list()
    interviews = list()
    sponsors = list()
    closing = list()
    for seg in segments:
        kind = seg.get("kind", "interview")
        if kind == "intro":
            intros.append(seg)
        elif kind == "sponsor":
            sponsors.append(seg)
        elif kind == "closing":
            closing.append(seg)
        else:
            interviews.append(seg)
    return intros, interviews, sponsors, closing


def check_technical(segments):
    """Split out unusable takes and the ambience beds that play underneath."""
    corrupted = list()
    effects = list()
    for seg in segments:
        duration = seg.get("duration", 0)
        if duration <= 0 or not seg.get("file"):
            corrupted.append(seg.get("file") or "<unnamed>")
        elif seg.get("kind") == "effect":
            effects.append(seg["file"])
    return corrupted, effects


def build_timeline(ordered, effects):
    """Lay clips end to end, recording start/end marks and guest appearances."""
    timestamps = dict()
    guest_map = dict()
    cursor = 0.0
    for seg in ordered:
        start = cursor
        cursor = round(cursor + seg["duration"], 3)
        timestamps[seg["file"]] = (start, cursor)
        guest = seg.get("guest")
        if guest:
            guest_map.setdefault(guest, list()).append(seg["file"])
    for name in effects:
        timestamps[name] = (0.0, cursor)
    return timestamps, guest_map


def format_rundown(timestamps, guest_map):
    """Human readable running order for the show notes."""
    lines = list()
    for name, (start, end) in timestamps.items():
        lines.append("{:>8.2f} - {:>8.2f}  {}".format(start, end, name))
    for guest, files in sorted(guest_map.items()):
        lines.append("guest {}: {}".format(guest, ", ".join(files)))
    return "\n".join(lines)


def edit(segments):
    corrupted, effects = check_technical(segments)
    usable = [s for s in segments if s.get("file") not in corrupted]
    intros, interviews, sponsors, closing = sort_clips(usable)
    ordered = list()
    for group in (intros, interviews, sponsors, closing):
        ordered.extend(group)
    ordered = [s for s in ordered if s.get("kind") != "effect"]
    timestamps, guest_map = build_timeline(ordered, effects)
    print(format_rundown(timestamps, guest_map))
    return timestamps, corrupted

def sort_by_color(rough):
    """Separate rough stones into colour families used by the workshop."""
    diamonds = list()
    rubies = list()
    sapphires = list()
    emeralds = list()
    for stone in rough:
        colour = stone.get("colour", "clear").lower()
        if colour == "clear":
            diamonds.append(stone)
        elif colour == "red":
            rubies.append(stone)
        elif colour == "blue":
            sapphires.append(stone)
        elif colour == "green":
            emeralds.append(stone)
    return diamonds, rubies, sapphires, emeralds


def find_flaws(stones):
    """Split off stones that cannot survive faceting."""
    shattered = list()
    heavily_included = list()
    keepers = list()
    for stone in stones:
        if stone.get("fractures", 0) > 2:
            shattered.append(stone)
        elif stone.get("inclusions", 0) > 5:
            heavily_included.append(stone)
        else:
            keepers.append(stone)
    return keepers, shattered, heavily_included


def appraise(stones, lab_prefix):
    """Record finished carat weights and issue certification codes."""
    carats = dict()
    certificates = dict()
    for index, stone in enumerate(stones, start=1):
        name = stone["name"]
        rough_weight = float(stone.get("weight", 0.0))
        yield_ratio = 0.45 if stone.get("inclusions", 0) else 0.6
        carats[name] = round(rough_weight * yield_ratio, 2)
        certificates[name] = "{0}-{1:04d}".format(lab_prefix, index)
    return carats, certificates


def report(carats, certificates, rejects):
    lines = list()
    for name in sorted(carats):
        lines.append("{0}: {1:.2f} ct ({2})".format(name, carats[name], certificates[name]))
    for stone in rejects:
        lines.append("{0}: rejected".format(stone["name"]))
    return "\n".join(lines)


def cut(rough):
    """Run the full lapidary pipeline over a sequence of raw stones."""
    diamonds, rubies, sapphires, emeralds = sort_by_color(rough)
    facetable = list()
    rejects = list()
    for batch in (diamonds, rubies, sapphires, emeralds):
        keepers, shattered, included = find_flaws(batch)
        facetable.extend(keepers)
        rejects.extend(shattered)
        rejects.extend(included)
    carats, certificates = appraise(facetable, "GEM")
    print(report(carats, certificates, rejects))
    return carats, diamonds

CATEGORY_BY_MATERIAL = {

FIELD_NAMES = ("trench", "material", "condition", "era", "researcher", "notable")


def parse_find(line):
    """Turn a pipe-separated field note into a find record."""
    fields = line.split("|")
    if len(fields) != len(FIELD_NAMES):
        raise ValueError("malformed field note: %r" % line)
    record = dict()
    for name, value in zip(FIELD_NAMES, fields):
        record[name] = value.strip()
    record["notable"] = record["notable"].lower() in ("yes", "true", "1")
    return record


def category_of(material):
    return CATEGORY_BY_MATERIAL.get(material.lower(), "unidentified")


def catalogue(finds):
    pottery = list()
    metal = list()
    biological = list()
    unidentified = list()
    buckets = {
        "pottery": pottery,
        "metal": metal,
        "biological": biological,
        "unidentified": unidentified,
    }
    trench_items = dict()
    researcher_finds = dict()
    era_items = dict()
    preservation_queue = list()
    reconstruction_queue = list()

    for find in finds:
        condition = find["condition"].lower()
        if condition == "debris":
            continue
        label = "%s (%s)" % (find["material"], find["era"])
        buckets[category_of(find["material"])].append(label)
        trench_items.setdefault(find["trench"], list()).append(label)
        era_items.setdefault(find["era"], list()).append(label)
        if find["notable"]:

        if condition == "intact":

        else:

    top_era = max(era_items, key=lambda era: (len(era_items[era]), era), default="")
    top_researcher = max(
        researcher_finds,

    lines.append("Dominant era: %s" % (top_era or "unknown"))
    lines.append("Leading researcher: %s" % (top_researcher or "none"))
    return "\n".join(lines)

def evaluate(hives):
    healthy_queens = list()
    mite_treatments = list()
    swarming = list()
    inactive = list()
    nectar_by_hive = dict()
    floral_visits = dict()
    inspector_notes = dict()
    weather_anomalies = list()
    gear_replacements = list()

    for log in hives:
        hive_id = log["hive"]
        if not log.get("active", True):
            inactive.append(hive_id)
            continue
        if log.get("queen_seen") and log.get("brood_pattern") == "solid":
            healthy_queens.append(hive_id)
        if log.get("mite_count", 0) >= 3:
            mite_treatments.append(hive_id)
        if log.get("queen_cells", 0) > 0 or log.get("bearding"):
            swarming.append(hive_id)

        nectar_by_hive.setdefault(hive_id, list()).append(log.get("nectar_kg", 0.0))

        for flower, visits in log.get("forage", dict()).items():
            floral_visits[flower] = floral_visits.get(flower, 0) + visits

        inspector = log.get("inspector", "unassigned")
        if inspector not in inspector_notes:
            inspector_notes[inspector] = list()
        if log.get("note"):
            inspector_notes[inspector].append((hive_id, log["note"]))

        anomaly = log.get("weather")
        if anomaly:
            weather_anomalies.append((log.get("date", ""), anomaly))
        for item in log.get("gear_replaced", list()):
            gear_replacements.append((log.get("date", ""), inspector, item))

    weather_anomalies.sort(key=lambda entry: entry[0])

    totals = dict()
    for hive_id, amounts in nectar_by_hive.items():
        totals[hive_id] = round(sum(amounts), 3)

    top_hive = max(totals, key=totals.get) if totals else None
    top_flower = max(floral_visits, key=floral_visits.get) if floral_visits else None
    return (top_hive, top_flower, len(swarming))


def summarize(hives):
    report = dict()
    top_hive, top_flower, swarm_count = evaluate(hives)
    report["top_hive"] = top_hive
    report["top_flower"] = top_flower
    report["swarming"] = swarm_count
    lines = list()
    lines.append("Most productive hive: {}".format(top_hive))
    lines.append("Primary floral source: {}".format(top_flower))
    lines.append("Swarming colonies: {}".format(swarm_count))

COST_RATES = {"gold": 12.5, "wood": 45.0, "personal": 30.0, "debris": 5.0}


def normalize_dive(raw):
    """Validate one raw dive log and return a complete, typed record."""
    if "diver" not in raw or "grid" not in raw:
        raise ValueError("dive log needs both 'diver' and 'grid'")
    cleaned = dict()
    cleaned["diver"] = str(raw["diver"]).strip()
    cleaned["grid"] = str(raw["grid"]).strip().upper()
    cleaned["bottom_time"] = float(raw.get("bottom_time", 0.0))
    cleaned["completed"] = bool(raw.get("completed", False))
    cleaned["finds"] = list(raw.get("finds", list()))
    cleaned["symptoms"] = list(raw.get("symptoms", list()))
    cleaned["broken"] = list(raw.get("broken", list()))
    return cleaned


def format_manifest(gold, wood, personal, junk):
    lines = list()
    lines.append("gold coins recovered: %d" % len(gold))
    lines.append("wooden artifacts preserved: %d" % len(wood))
    lines.append("passenger belongings bagged: %d" % len(personal))
    lines.append("unidentifiable debris logged: %d" % len(junk))
    return lines


def summarize_safety(incidents, maintenance):
    counts = dict()
    for symptom in incidents:
        counts[symptom] = counts.get(symptom, 0) + 1
    ranked = sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda pair: (-pair[1], pair[0]))
    detail = ", ".join("%s x%d" % (name, n) for name, n in ranked) or "none"
    return "DCS symptoms: %s | equipment awaiting repair: %d" % (detail, len(maintenance))


def coordinate(dives):
    gold_coins = list()
    wooden_artifacts = list()
    belongings = list()
    debris = list()
    grid_status = dict()
    bottom_times = dict()
    preservation_costs = dict()
    incidents = list()
    maintenance_queue = list()
    gold_by_grid = dict()
    for raw in dives:
        dive = normalize_dive(raw)
        grid, diver = dive["grid"], dive["diver"]
        grid_status[grid] = grid_status.get(grid, False) or dive["completed"]
        bottom_times[diver] = bottom_times.get(diver, 0.0) + dive["bottom_time"]
        incidents.extend(dive["symptoms"])
        maintenance_queue.extend(dive["broken"])
        for item in dive["finds"]:
            kind = str(item.get("type", "debris")).lower()
            count = int(item.get("count", 1))
            label = item.get("label", kind)
            rate = COST_RATES.get(kind, COST_RATES["debris"])
            preservation_costs[kind] = preservation_costs.get(kind, 0.0) + rate * count
            if kind == "gold":
                gold_coins.extend([label] * count)
                gold_by_grid[grid] = gold_by_grid.get(grid, 0) + count
            elif kind == "wood":
                wooden_artifacts.extend([label] * count)
            elif kind == "personal":
                belongings.extend([label] * count)
            else:
                debris.extend([label] * count)
    searched = {g: n for g, n in gold_by_grid.items() if grid_status.get(g)}
    pool = searched or gold_by_grid
    richest = max(pool, key=lambda g: (pool[g], g)) if pool else ""
    top_diver = max(bottom_times, key=lambda d: (bottom_times[d], d)) if bottom_times else ""
    for line in format_manifest(gold_coins, wooden_artifacts, belongings, debris):
        print(line)
    print(summarize_safety(incidents, maintenance_queue))
    return (richest, top_diver, round(sum(preservation_costs.values()), 2))

def classify(crater):
    if crater.get("eroded"):
        return "eroded"
    if crater.get("secondary"):
        return "secondary"
    if crater["depth"] >= 50.0:
        return "deep"
    return "shallow"


def group_by_sector(craters):
    groups = dict()
    for crater in craters:
        groups.setdefault(crater["sector"], list()).append(crater["name"])
    return groups


def survey(craters):
    shallow_depressions = list()
    deep_penetrations = list()
    secondary_strikes = list()
    eroded_sites = list()
    sector_radiation = dict()
    mineral_ages = dict()
    geologist_samples = dict()
    unexplained_phenomena = list()
    equipment_replacements = list()
    buckets = {
        "shallow": shallow_depressions,
        "deep": deep_penetrations,
        "secondary": secondary_strikes,
        "eroded": eroded_sites,
    }
    for crater in craters:
        buckets[classify(crater)].append(crater["name"])
        sector = crater["sector"]
        radiation = float(crater["radiation"])
        if radiation > sector_radiation.get(sector, -1.0):
            sector_radiation[sector] = radiation
        mineral = crater["mineral"]
        age = int(crater["age"])
        if age > mineral_ages.get(mineral, -1):
            mineral_ages[mineral] = age
        collected = geologist_samples.setdefault(crater["geologist"], list())
        collected.extend(crater.get("samples", list()))
        if crater.get("magnetic_anomaly"):
            unexplained_phenomena.append((crater["name"], crater["magnetic_anomaly"]))
        for tool in crater.get("damaged_equipment", list()):
            equipment_replacements.append(tool)
    hottest_sector = max(sector_radiation, key=sector_radiation.get)
    oldest_mineral = max(mineral_ages, key=mineral_ages.get)
    return hottest_sector, oldest_mineral, len(deep_penetrations)


def format_report(craters, result):
    hottest_sector, oldest_mineral, deep_count = result
    lines = list()
    lines.append("Hottest sector: %s" % hottest_sector)
    lines.append("Oldest mineral: %s" % oldest_mineral)
    lines.append("Deep penetration craters: %d" % deep_count)
    for sector, names in sorted(group_by_sector(craters).items()):
        lines.append("  %s -> %s" % (sector, ", ".join(sorted(names))))
    return "\n".join(lines)

            retreating.append(sector)

        discharge[valley] = discharge.get(valley, 0.0) + record["discharge"]
        thickness.setdefault(tuple(record["coord"]), list()).append(record["thickness"])

def direct(logs):
    automated_beacons = list()
    manned_towers = list()
    offshore_platforms = list()
    decommissioned_sites = list()
    bulb_wattage = dict()
    storm_tally = dict()
    technician_routes = dict()
    critical_repairs = list()
    maritime_feedback = list()

    for entry in logs:
        kind = entry.get("type", "")
        name = entry.get("name", "")
        if kind == "automated":
            automated_beacons.append(name)
        elif kind == "manned":
            manned_towers.append(name)
        elif kind == "offshore":
            offshore_platforms.append(name)
        elif kind == "decommissioned":
            decommissioned_sites.append(name)

        if "wattage" in entry:
            bulb_wattage[name] = entry["wattage"]

        region = entry.get("region")
        if region:
            storm_tally[region] = storm_tally.get(region, 0) + entry.get("storms", 0)

        technician = entry.get("technician")
        if technician:
            route = technician_routes.setdefault(technician, list())
            route.extend(entry.get("route", list()))

        if entry.get("crack"):
            critical_repairs.append((name, entry["crack"]))
        if entry.get("complaint"):
            maritime_feedback.append((entry.get("ship", "unknown"), entry["complaint"]))

    worst_region = max(storm_tally, key=storm_tally.get) if storm_tally else None
    busiest = None
    if technician_routes:
        busiest = max(technician_routes, key=lambda t: len(technician_routes[t]))
    return (worst_region, busiest, len(offshore_platforms))

WALL_STRENGTH = 100
GARRISON_SIZE = 8
FIRE_BONUS = 10
INCENDIARY = ("fire arrow", "greek fire")
WEAPONS = {
    "ram": (30, 2),
    "catapult": (45, 3),
    "trebuchet": (60, 4),
    "ladder": (15, 1),
    "siege tower": (50, 3),
    "fire arrow": (20, 1),
    "greek fire": (35, 2),
}
DEFAULT_WEAPON = (10, 1)


def initialize_state(events):
    wall_damage = dict()
    garrison = dict()
    fires = list()
    for sector, weapon in events:
        wall_damage.setdefault(sector, 0)
        garrison.setdefault(sector, GARRISON_SIZE)
        if weapon in INCENDIARY and sector not in fires:
            fires.append(sector)
    return wall_damage, garrison, fires


def resolve_attacks(events, wall_damage, garrison, fires):
    breached = list()
    fallen = list()
    depleted = dict()
    for sector, weapon in events:
        damage, casualties = WEAPONS.get(weapon, DEFAULT_WEAPON)
        if sector in fires:
            damage += FIRE_BONUS
        wall_damage[sector] += damage
        losses = min(garrison[sector], casualties)
        garrison[sector] -= losses
        fallen.extend("%s-%d" % (sector, n) for n in range(losses))
        depleted.setdefault(weapon, list()).append(sector)
        if wall_damage[sector] >= WALL_STRENGTH and sector not in breached:
            breached.append(sector)
    return breached, fallen, depleted


def assess(garrison, breached, depleted):
    surviving = list()
    captured = list()
    for sector in sorted(garrison):
        troops = garrison[sector]
        if sector in breached:
            troops //= 2
        surviving.extend("%s#%d" % (sector, n + 1) for n in range(troops))
    for weapon, targets in sorted(depleted.items()):
        if all(sector not in breached for sector in targets):
            captured.append(weapon)
    return surviving, captured


def battle_report(events):
    wall_damage, garrison, fires = initialize_state(events)
    breached, fallen, depleted = resolve_attacks(events, wall_damage, garrison, fires)
    surviving, captured = assess(garrison, breached, depleted)
    summary = dict()

def sort_events(tremors):

        record["tsunami_risk"] += magnitude - 5.0 if depth < 200.0 else 0.4

        record["magma_pressure"] += magnitude * 2.0 - depth / 50.0
        record["crustal_stress"] += magnitude * 0.3

def validate(samples):
    """Clean the raw balloon telemetry and order it by altitude."""
    cleaned = list()
    for entry in samples:
        if len(entry) != 3:
            raise ValueError("each sample needs altitude, concentration, temperature")
        altitude, concentration, temperature = entry
        cleaned.append((float(altitude), float(concentration), float(temperature)))
    cleaned.sort(key=lambda reading: reading[0])
    return cleaned


def categorize(readings):
    """Sort readings into carbon dioxide layers, methane pockets and N2O traces."""
    layers = dict()
    layers["carbon_dioxide"] = list()
    layers["methane"] = list()
    layers["nitrous_oxide"] = list()
    for reading in readings:
        concentration = reading[1]
        if concentration >= 350.0:
            layers["carbon_dioxide"].append(reading)
        elif concentration >= 50.0:
            layers["methane"].append(reading)
        else:
            layers["nitrous_oxide"].append(reading)
    return layers


def map_climate(readings):
    """Associate every altitude with its climate indicators."""
    climate = dict()
    previous_temperature = None
    for altitude, concentration, temperature in readings:
        traits = dict()
        traits["ozone_depletion"] = round(concentration / 450.0, 3)
        traits["thermal_inversion"] = (previous_temperature is not None
                                       and temperature > previous_temperature)
        traits["solar_absorption"] = round(concentration * (1.0 + altitude / 10000.0), 1)
        climate[altitude] = traits
        previous_temperature = temperature
    return climate


def forecast(layers, climate):
    """Compile severe warming zones and stable atmospheric layers."""
    gas_at_altitude = dict()
    for gas, group in layers.items():
        for altitude, _concentration, _temperature in group:
            gas_at_altitude[altitude] = gas
    severe_zones = list()
    stable_layers = list()
    for altitude in sorted(climate):
        traits = climate[altitude]
        warming = traits["ozone_depletion"] > 0.8 and (traits["thermal_inversion"]
                                                       or traits["solar_absorption"] > 400.0)
        if warming and gas_at_altitude[altitude] != "nitrous_oxide":
            severe_zones.append(altitude)
        else:
            stable_layers.append(altitude)
    return severe_zones, stable_layers


def _analyze(samples):

    layers = categorize(readings)
    climate = map_climate(readings)
    severe_zones, stable_layers = forecast(layers, climate)
    return layers, climate, severe_zones, stable_layers

The mapping step evaluates mathematical bounds to associate coordinates with polar distortions, valid mercator regions, and robinson interpolations.
